description: Much of the magazine also focused on hair and makeup, which always followed a hyper-feminine and kawaii style, with liberal use of pinks, browns, and glitter. The hairstyles are incredibly elaborate, with bangs being a must.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Sophistication, femininity, youth

visualDNA.colour: Varied, with pink and black as the most themed photo spreads

fashion.Overview: The second half of the video shows Risa Nakamura's styling process, which inspired Larme Kei Note: The fashion included in Larme Kei for this section describes the western interpretation of the fashion, as opposed to the real magazine, which includes outfits that may not be in line with the traditional image of "Larme Kei." This fashion aesthetic is present in multiple issues of Larme, but Larme itself contains multiple styles and does not identify the typical outfit formulas as attributed to them inherently.
fashion.Tops: The tops in Larme Kei contain various feminine details. These include:
fashion.Bottoms: Most often, pencil skirts (or other form-fitting skirts) are worn in the fashion. This allows for either a vintage and sophisticated, or a sexy element to exist to contrast the more feminine and girly top. An incredibly viral item that became mimicked by multiple brands is a pencil skirt with an attached "garter belt" in the form of a peplum and dangling garters attached to the skirt. Another type of skirt is one where a mini skirt is under a sheer maxi skirt. This would often be attached…
fashion.Dresses: Most dresses include the same elements as the tops and bottoms above, but attached together. Strap and slip dresses are often worn over tops and are often in a contrasting texture, such as satin, sheer, pleated, etc.
fashion.Shoes: For a while, there was a microtrend of putting fur and feathers on shoes to mimic the incredibly popular and sexualized marabou mules. Larme magazine (and thus Larme Kei) emphasized the femininity of the style by exclusively wearing heels or platform shoes in classic styles, which tend to be Mary Janes, pumps, T-straps, etc. These shoes would almost always be paired with lace or sheer socks or tights. This would be in a more classic design.
fashion.Accessories: Most often, Larme Kei wearers incorporated a choker into their outfit, often contrasting the top. For example, if the top was mature and sexy, the choker would be pink and have a heart charm, while a pink outfit would include a black and collar-esque style.
fashion.Hair and Makeup: The models almost always had bangs that covered their forehead, either bluntly or in a wispy style. This is because it is common in Japan and signifies femininity, making this style seen in multiple Japanese fashions. And because Larme Kei wearers in the West often dabble in multiple J-fashions, they also wore these bangs. Multiple spreads in Larme magazine and Japanese blogs featured tutorials for intricate braids, often incorporating ribbons and hairclips.
